title: Fall entertaining ramps — cheese-board season
insight: Sept–Nov is peak board & grazing demand for specialty grocers and chef menus; buyers set fall assortments now.
suggestedAngle: Lead with the alpine-origin story and the Asiago DOP range; the provenance is the board's centerpiece.

title: Holiday gifting build for Q4
insight: Grocers lock gift & DTC box programs in summer for Q4; a heritage story sells the gift, not the spec sheet.
suggestedAngle: Frame the 100-year family story — a gift with a place and a name behind it.

title: Provenance & local-sourcing demand rising
insight: Consumers and buyers increasingly reward single-origin, traceable specialty cheese over generic 'Made in Italy'.
suggestedAngle: Made at altitude, milk from within 90 km — the mountain origin is the product, not a marketing line.

title: Fall menu refresh — grating cheese for pasta programs
insight: Chefs refresh pasta and risotto menus into fall; hard grating cheeses with a real DOP story upsell the plate.
suggestedAngle: Everything made at home — one hand, start to finish; the grating cheese a chef can name on the menu.

title: Distributor fall line-review / reset window
insight: Distributors run fall line reviews now; a tight range with a single-source quality story wins slots.
suggestedAngle: Nothing outsourced, nothing anonymous — a certified dairy at 800m, wheels handled start to finish.

title: DOP / PDO authenticity scrutiny
insight: Retail and trade attention on genuine PDO labeling favors certified DOP producers over imitators.
suggestedAngle: Certified DOP, made and aged in our own Alpine plants — the certification and the place both check out.

title: Alpine / mountain cheeses trending on specialty menus
insight: Mountain and Alpine cheeses are gaining menu and case space; few importers own a credible altitude story.
suggestedAngle: Why Trentino — cows graze in the Dolomites' shade; a story competitors on the shelf can't claim.

title: Grocer deli reset — back-to-routine everyday cheese
insight: Post-summer deli resets favor dependable everyday SKUs with a warm, family-brand feel.
suggestedAngle: A family creamery's everyday range — quality you can put a name and a hundred-year story to.
